    TAKE THIS WITH YOU
    The Prompt Critic's Checklist
    • Describe your sheet. Copilot cannot see your screen; say which columns, which rows and what you want, like a phone call to someone who cannot see it.
    • Name the real problem. "Clean up my spreadsheet" gets a guess; "four spellings of Done in the Status column" gets a fix.
    • Supply the facts, especially dates. Copilot fills every gap with something plausible; our financial year starts 1 July, and it will not ask.
    • Describe the symptom, not the mood. The exact formula, what it shows, and the tell you noticed; vent to a colleague instead.
    • Data stays out of the chat. Copilot can teach you the method without the names and numbers; describe the columns, never paste the list.
    • Ask to be taught. A bare formula just tempts; ask for the steps and the reasoning so the understanding stays with you.
    • Test before it counts. Confident does not mean correct; run every suggested formula on rows where you already know the right answer.
    • Copilot suggests, you decide. Read the whole reply; ranges, cells and claims all get a human once-over before they touch your sheet.
